source.title: It Must Be Destroyed
source.description:
This orb is indeed connected to a powerful entity, somewhere beyond the Twisting Nether. I cannot divine its nature, but I feel its perception reaching through the orb... studying me in return.

I am reluctant to admit this, <name>, but the orb must be destroyed.

It seems impervious to most damage, but it may be vulnerable to the weapon of a powerful demon lord. I am unsure where you will find such a weapon, but it remains your best option.

Good luck, <name>.
source.objective: Find a way to destroy the orb.
source.progress: <Your hair stands on end as infernal energies surround you>
source.completion: <You raise the orb towards the spear>
